config.json of the supported language-model checkpoints, fetched 2026-11-10
from https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/main/config.json. They let the
tests build the exact published architectures (with the widths scaled down)
without downloading any weights.

File name = the canonical repository, with "/" written "__".

The meta-llama/* and google/* repositories are gated, so their configs were
taken from the ungated unsloth mirrors, which carry the same architecture
fields (plus a few bookkeeping keys such as unsloth_fixed / unsloth_version):

  meta-llama__Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct.json  <- unsloth/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct
  meta-llama__Llama-3.2-1B.json            <- unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B
  meta-llama__Llama-3.2-3B.json            <- unsloth/Llama-3.2-3B
  meta-llama__Llama-3.1-8B.json            <- unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B
  google__gemma-2-{2b,9b,27b}.json         <- unsloth/gemma-2-{2b,9b,27b}
  google__gemma-3-{270m,1b-it,4b-it,12b-it,27b-it}.json
                                           <- unsloth/gemma-3-{...}

Fetched directly from the canonical repository:

  Qwen__Qwen3.5-4B.json, Qwen__Qwen3.5-27B.json
  Qwen__Qwen3-8B.json, Qwen__Qwen3-14B.json
  HuggingFaceTB__SmolLM2-{135M,360M,1.7B}.json
